about_the_game:
The Pigeon Guild has kept communities connected across the sky for hundreds of years. One parcel at a time. As their newest recruit, you'll discover that being a postal pigeon means far more than you expected. Master the art of delivery, piloting your flying cargo boat amongst the scattered islands of Cassandria, bringing parcels and unexpected cargo to their rightful owners.

KEY FEATURES

  • A lighthearted role-playing game in a 3D fantasy universe

  • Play as a 15 year old boy, thrown into a fragmented world

  • Explore at your own pace, without the pressure of combat

  • Battle the weather, from raging winds to rain, sunny skies, tornadoes, storms, and fog, to test your delivery skills.

  • Artstyle inspired by Hayao Miyazaki and Akira Toriyama

In Pigeon Guild, you're not just delivering mail. You're bringing back the heartbeat of an entire community. Each delivery uncovers stories and mends relationships, revealing what truly connects the community. Handle everything from delivering a long-lost love letter, escorting a kitten to a mad scientist, or dealing with a suspicious ticking package.

Navigate changing weather, solve puzzles, and use your wit and detective skills to restore the Pigeon Guild as a trusted postal service in Cassandria. Along the way, discover how every delivery brings you closer to the truth behind your mother’s disappearance all those years ago.

Ready to earn your wings?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4570 or AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 760 or Radeon HD 7950 (2GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a dedicated GPU and is based on low graphics settings.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7600 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 970 or Radeon R9 390 (4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Based on High/Ultra graphics settings. Dedicated GPU required, SSD recommended.

short_description: Pigeon Guild is an adventure RPG with no combat. You play as Jules Corso, a rookie cadet in an airborne postal service. Pilot your flying cargo boat through Cassandria - a world of floating islands where every delivery tells a story.
